explanation.summary: Phone generates the highest revenue among all products at 55300, while South is the top-performing region with 35300 in revenue. There is a strong positive correlation between units sold and revenue.

findings.title: Top Product Performance
findings.statement: Phone generates the highest revenue at 55300.
findings.why: Identifying the top-performing product helps focus marketing and inventory efforts on the most profitable items.
findings.limitation: The small dataset size (10 rows) may limit statistical significance of these findings.

findings.title: Strongest Region
findings.statement: South region is the top performer with 35300 in revenue, representing 29.4% of the total revenue.
findings.why: Knowing the strongest region allows for targeted regional strategies and resource allocation.
findings.limitation: Revenue difference between South (35300) and North (34700) is minimal, suggesting relatively balanced regional performance.

findings.title: Units-Revenue Relationship
findings.statement: There is a strong positive correlation (0.7892) between units sold and revenue with statistical significance (p-value: 0.006645).
findings.why: This relationship confirms that selling more units generally leads to higher revenue, supporting volume-based sales strategies.
findings.limitation: Correlation doesn't imply causation; other factors may influence revenue beyond just units sold.
